business_summary: LingNan Eco&Culture-Tourism Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning and design, water conservancy, water affairs and water environment, municipal and landscaping, cultural technology and tourism, and other businesses in China. The company provides ecological environment, urban landscaping, rural landscape, ecological landscape, municipal public works, and smart city construction, as well as ecological protection and environmental governance. It is also involved in the planning, design, construction, and operation services; water resources and water environment management business; cultural tourism business; land construction; green management; theme culture and creativity; and landscaping and ecological restoration activities. The company was formerly known as LingNan Landscape Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LingNan Eco&Culture-Tourism Co.,Ltd. in February 2018. LingNan Eco&Culture-Tourism Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Dongguan, China.
